text: Rabobank is one of the Netherlands' largest cooperatives, with nearly two million members; it has members rather than shareholders.
short: Rabobank is a cooperative with members rather than shareholders.

source.name: Rabobank: A bank with members — Rabobank as cooperative
source.quote: What makes Rabobank as a cooperative different from other banks? We have members rather than shareholders.
source.note: Archived copy of Rabobank's cooperative page (rabobank.com blocked our network on 2026-10-03); the same page states: 'Rabobank is one of the Netherlands’ largest cooperatives with nearly two million members.'
